name: MergerAnalyst Model Merger-Arb Portfolio (US & Europe)
disclaimer: Model portfolio for illustration only. Not investment advice, not a real trading account, no fees, borrow costs or slippage.

rules.universe: Active (pending) DEALS rows with a US, UK or European target. Excludes at-risk, hostile, contested-without-agreement and rumored deals.
qualityScreen: Signed definitive agreement (or recommended UK/Irish scheme or offer)
Financing committed (no financing condition, or UK/Irish Code cash confirmation)
Limited antitrust/regulatory risk: no second request, CMA Phase 2 / EU Phase 2, sector-regulator veto risk, or contested high-threshold tender condition
Target board recommendation and/or shareholder support
Sensible return: annualized spread of at least ~3% (at least ~5% for the daily add screen), unless closing is imminent
rules.sizing: Equal weight 7% of NAV per name at entry, hard cap 10%. Unallocated capital sits in cash (0% return).
rules.hedging: Stock and cash+stock deals with a fixed exchange ratio: short the acquirer at the ratio on entry (proceeds credited to cash). Fixed-dollar or NAV-based stock legs are not share-hedged.
rules.pricing: Entries and daily marks use closing prices from the site's live quote feed (Yahoo-backed) in each listing's local currency; returns are measured in local currency (FX assumed hedged).
rules.closings: When a deal completes it is booked at deal value (cash plus ratio x acquirer close); the hedge is covered with the acquirer shares received.
rules.breaks: When a deal is terminated it is sold at that day's close and the loss is booked; the hedge is covered at the acquirer close.
rules.rebalancing: No rebalancing of open positions. Cash from closings and breaks is redeployed into new names that pass the screen, at 7% each, only while cash stays at or above 5% of NAV after the purchase.
rules.nav: NAV = cash + long market value - short market value, recorded once per trading day after the US close (stamped with the session date).

excludedAtInception.reason: FTC Second Request; closing timing agreement
Outstanding state insurance approvals; ~60% spread signals high perceived risk
Pending UK antitrust approval with FirstCash's existing H&T pawn network
Private-equity buyer of an airline: UK/EU ownership-and-control rules
Reported competing bid; terms may change
Highly levered buyer; outside date late 2027
e.g. ITGR, MKTX, PCRX, TECH, BOW: annualized return below ~3% with no imminent close

previousVersion.note: July 2026 model (28 positions, static price snapshot of 2026-07-17, not tracked after launch). Archived; superseded by this portfolio.

positions.acquirer: Ares Capital Corporation (Nasdaq: ARCC), with cash contribution from a subsidiary of Ares Management (NYSE: ARES)
positions.rationale: Ares Capital (largest US BDC) buying MFIC for $10.88/share ($1.21 cash + $9.67 of ARCC stock, priced at the greater of ARCC NAV or market). Strategic, well-capitalised buyer; both boards unanimous, Apollo affiliates support; no antitrust overlap. The stock leg is a fixed dollar amount converted at closing, so there is no static share hedge.
TowneBank in-market acquisition of blueharbor bank: $12.70 cash + 1.0534 TOWN per share. Small, routine bank approval; boards approved. Stock leg hedged by shorting 1.0534 TOWN per share.
Pontiac Bancorp all-cash $19.78/share for Ottawa Bancorp. Small community-bank deal, routine regulatory approvals, board approved; Q1 2027 close. Thinly traded.

onsemi all-cash $123/share (amended Oct 1). Strategic buyer, cash on hand plus fully committed Morgan Stanley debt. The board reaffirmed onsemi over an unsolicited rival proposal, which also supports the price. Mid-2027 close.
Texas Instruments all-cash $231/share. Strategic, investment-grade buyer; shareholders approved and US HSR expired; only remaining foreign approvals. H1 2027 close.
Schneider Electric all-cash $205/share. Strategic, investment-grade buyer with limited product overlap; board unanimous. Longer-dated (Q3 2027 assumption).
EnerSys all-cash $16/share tender offer funded from cash on hand, no financing condition; holders of ~40% have tender support agreements. HSR and UK NSIA clearances; offer expires Dec 3 (extendable).
Teledyne all-cash $18.90/share. Strategic serial acquirer, ample liquidity; boards unanimous. HSR and foreign clearances, early 2027 close.

positions.acquirer: Bradbury Bidco Limited, a vehicle formed by funds managed by Epiris GP III Limited
positions.rationale: Epiris-backed Bradbury Bidco recommended cash offer, 1,120p/share by scheme. UK Takeover Code cash confirmation means the funding is committed; board recommends. Q1 2027.

positions.acquirer: Veritas Capital Fund Management, L.L.C. (through a newly incorporated bidding vehicle)
positions.rationale: Veritas Capital recommended cash offer, 932.8p/share by scheme (the 7.2p interim dividend has been paid). Committed funding under the Code; board recommends; NSIA review expected routine. Q1 2027.

positions.acquirer: BAWAG P.S.K. (BAWAG Group AG, Vienna: BG)
positions.rationale: BAWAG all-cash EUR 2.97/share by Irish scheme. Irish State (largest holder) supports; shareholders approved; the High Court sanction hearing began Oct 27, so completion is near (Q4 2026).

positions.acquirer: Thrive Holdings (permanent-capital holding company affiliated with Thrive Capital)
positions.rationale: Thrive Holdings all-cash $10/share with debt fully committed by Apollo funds, no financing condition. Board approved; HSR only; the go-shop to Nov 28 is optional upside. Q1 2027.
Merck KGaA all-cash $20/ADS by UK scheme. Strategic, investment-grade buyer; board unanimous, ~14% of votes committed. Q1 2027.
